item.title: Kirk Franklin to Host 2026 Stellar Gospel Music Awards: Here’s the Full Nominations List
item.description:
Here's a short, engaging podcast script based on the article:
[Intro music plays]
Host: "Welcome to our podcast, where we celebrate the best in gospel music. I've got some exciting news to share with you today. The Stellar Gospel Music Awards are just around the corner, and we're honoring two incredible artists with some very special awards."
[Soft music transitions in]
Host: "Tasha Cobbs Leonard will be receiving the prestigious Aretha Franklin Icon Award at this year's ceremony. This award is a testament to her outstanding contributions to the gospel music industry, and we couldn't be more thrilled for her. In a statement, Tasha shared her gratitude, saying, 'This honor means more to me than I can fully express... I'm grateful to my family, my team, the gospel community, and every person who has allowed this music to become part of their lives.'"
[Soft music continues]
Host: "And that's not all. Pastor Mike Jr. will be receiving the Thomas A. Dorsey Most Notable Achievement Award. He shared his excitement, saying, 'I'm truly honored to receive this award... This recognition is bigger than me, it's a testament to God's faithfulness and the incredible people who have supported this journey.'"
[Upbeat music transitions in]
Host: "The 41st annual Stellar Gospel Music Awards will feature an amazing lineup of performances, including Aaron Cole, Kierra Sheard, and Tye Tribbett, to name just a few. And don't worry if you can't make it to the live taping in Charlotte – the show will premiere on The Stellar Network and later on BET, with encore presentations and broadcast TV syndication to follow."
[Outro music plays]
Host: "That's all for today, folks. Congratulations to Tasha Cobbs Leonard and Pastor Mike Jr. on their well-deserved awards. We can't wait to see what this year's Stellar Gospel Music Awards have in store. Thanks for tuning in, and we'll catch you on the next episode!"
[Outro music continues to play until the end]
